meta.notes: The shaded band and the three vertical rules are all drawn from the rate scalars, so changing a required rate moves the band, the rule and the label together. The highlighted crossing is (rate10, irishatrate10) -- it is plotted from those two scalars, not from literal coordinates, so the '77% of the time' annotation cannot drift away from the curve.
